title: Disability representation on county commissions
summary: On August 13, a commissioner described harsh treatment by police during an arrest and asked that someone who understands disability sit on the police commission. This follows a July 9 request from a commissioner to discuss giving people with disabilities a seat on every commission. The facts do not show whether any seat has been created or approved.
